verdict.rationale: Mastra is code-first: agents and workflows are registered on a Mastra server and can ship as standalone endpoints, so there is a programmatic surface alongside the Studio UI. However, no evidence shows that the API matches everything Studio does for building, testing and managing. One team user reports repeatedly writing their own Hono routes, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: documented parity between Studio and the API, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec for management operations, API coverage of Studio's testing, inspection and eval functions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
